ext.ai.admin.agent.disabledBody: Turn it on under Settings → Agent. It acts on the panel itself, so it is gated separately from the assistant your customers see.
ext.ai.admin.agent.disabledTitle: The admin assistant is switched off
ext.ai.admin.agent.disclaimer: The assistant only acts through your own admin permissions, and every change is shown to you first.
ext.ai.admin.agent.emptySubtitle: I can look up customers, servers, products, coupons and tickets, and make changes to the catalogue for you to approve. I cannot reach into a customer’s server — open that server’s own assistant for that.
ext.ai.admin.agent.placeholder: Ask about customers, products, coupons or tickets…
ext.ai.admin.agent.title: Admin assistant
ext.ai.admin.assist.logged: This session appears in the customer's own activity log.
ext.ai.admin.logs.cachedHint: Served from the response cache — no tokens used.
ext.ai.admin.logs.title: Request log
ext.ai.admin.needsConfiguration: The AI provider isn't fully configured yet — open Settings to finish setup.
ext.ai.admin.overview.budgetOff: No token budget is enforced — set one in Budget & access.
ext.ai.admin.overview.inferenceUnavailab: Could not reach the inference backend.
ext.ai.admin.overview.queueNotApplicable: Hosted providers are not queued — spend is the limit, not VRAM.
ext.ai.admin.overview.slowest: Slowest {value}. An agent turn is many model calls, so a long one is not necessarily a stall.
ext.ai.admin.overview.toolsUnsupported: The agent model cannot call tools
ext.ai.admin.pages.agentDesc: Which assistants exist. Each is gated separately — turning on chat must not hand anything the ability to act.
ext.ai.admin.pages.budgetHostedDesc: This provider bills per token, so spend is the binding constraint. One agent turn is many model calls, and per-request rate limits give no meaningful ceiling.
ext.ai.admin.pages.budgetSelfHostedDesc: Self-hosted inference is bounded by hardware rather than spend, but a token ceiling still caps how much of the day one runaway turn can occupy.
ext.ai.admin.pages.generationDesc: How much the model may produce, and how much freedom it has doing it.
ext.ai.admin.pages.modelDesc: The model everything runs on, and the two places that can override it.
ext.ai.admin.pages.performanceDesc: Keeping self-hosted inference busy without thrashing it.
ext.ai.admin.pages.privacyDesc: Pattern and field-name masking applied before a request leaves the panel. This reduces exposure but does not de-identify free text, and never applies to what you type.
ext.ai.admin.pages.providerDesc: Where the panel sends its inference, and what it authenticates with.
ext.ai.admin.pages.residencyDesc: How long a model stays loaded. Unloading frees VRAM; reloading costs the next person a cold start.
ext.ai.admin.pages.turnLimitsDesc: A turn is bounded three ways, because any one of them alone can be escaped: a model can loop cheaply, stall expensively, or both.
ext.ai.admin.settings.adminAgentEnabledH: Lets the assistant read and edit the panel itself — customers, servers, products and coupons — limited to what your own admin role allows. Off by default.
ext.ai.admin.settings.agentEnabledHint: Lets users ask the assistant to act on their servers, within their own permissions.
ext.ai.admin.settings.agentReasoningHint: Ask the model to reason before it acts, and show that reasoning in the transcript. Improves tool choice on long tasks; costs extra output tokens and a little latency. Models without a reasoning mode ignore it.
ext.ai.admin.settings.allowDestructiveBa: Allow destructive calls in a batch
Off means a batch containing one is refused and the model must ask for it on its own. The card still names every target and still asks for the typed confirmation once.
ext.ai.admin.settings.batchingDesc: Several changes reviewed and approved as one set, instead of one card each.
ext.ai.admin.settings.budgetEnforceHint: One agent turn is many model calls, so rate limits alone cap nothing.
ext.ai.admin.settings.contextTokensHint: 0 uses the model's own window. Context is paid for in VRAM.
ext.ai.admin.settings.contextUnboundBody: This model reports a {tokens}-token window and will be loaded at its full size. That is usually more VRAM than the model weights themselves. Set a limit unless you need the whole window.
ext.ai.admin.settings.effectNote: Changes take effect on the next request after saving.
ext.ai.admin.settings.endpointCompatible: Enter the /v1 base URL exposed by your self-hosted server.
ext.ai.admin.settings.endpointOpenaiHint: Must be HTTPS and end in /v1.
ext.ai.admin.settings.endpointOpenrouter: Managed by the panel and fixed to OpenRouter's global API.
ext.ai.admin.settings.footerNote: The API key is stored encrypted and never sent back to the browser.
ext.ai.admin.settings.keepAliveHint: How long Ollama keeps the model in memory after a request. Longer = fewer cold starts, more VRAM held.
ext.ai.admin.settings.keyRemoved: The API key has been removed.
ext.ai.admin.settings.maxBatchCallsHint: How many changes the model may put in one approval. Every call is written in a single response, so lower it alongside the tool limit for a small model.
ext.ai.admin.settings.maxRepairsHint: When the model writes a malformed tool call, how many times to ask again under a strict schema. Each one is a second inference over the whole transcript; 0 turns repairs off.
ext.ai.admin.settings.maxStepsHint: How many tool calls one request may chain.
ext.ai.admin.settings.maxToolSecondsHint: The turn limit above is only checked between steps, so this is what stops one stuck call. An overrun fails as a tool, not as the turn.
ext.ai.admin.settings.maxToolsAutoHint: Auto: {profile}, {schemas} capability tools ({total} including core). {reason} Detection confidence: {confidence}. Turn off Auto to set it yourself.
ext.ai.admin.settings.maxToolsHint: How many tool schemas the model chooses between each step. The rest stay reachable through search — lower this if the model keeps picking the wrong tool.
ext.ai.admin.settings.maxWaitHint: How long a turn waits for a slot before giving up.
ext.ai.admin.settings.maxWallHint: A turn is abandoned once it runs this long. Between 30 and 900 seconds; the browser waits this long plus a margin before treating a silent turn as lost.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modeAnthropicHint: Connects to the official Anthropic API. Requires an Anthropic API key and API billing.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modeCompatibleHint: Choose this for llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM, or another local /v1 Chat Completions server. An API key is optional.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modeLocalHint: Connect to Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, vLLM, or another local model server. An API key is optional.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modeOllamaHint: Choose this only for native Ollama. The panel uses Ollama's /api/chat features; no API key is required.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modeOpenaiHint: Connects to the official OpenAI API. Requires an API Platform key and billing; a ChatGPT or Codex subscription is not an API key.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modeOpenrouterHint: Uses OpenRouter's free-model router with enforced data-collection denial and full panel-context redaction. Requires an OpenRouter API key.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modelAvailableHint: Pick an available model below or type a name.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modelDiscoveredHin: Pick an installed model below or type a name.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modelExactHint: Enter the exact model ID exposed by your server.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modelOpenrouterHin: Fixed to openrouter/free. OpenRouter automatically chooses a compatible free model, which may change between requests or agent steps.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modelPresetHint: Suggestions only. Verify a model is available from your provider, then type its name above.
ext.ai.admin.settings.modelsUnavailable: Couldn't list models from the endpoint — check the connection, then refresh.
ext.ai.admin.settings.monthlyTokensHint: Owners are exempt. Queue refusals are never charged. With enforcement on, 0 is an allowance of zero rather than unlimited — turn enforcement off instead.
ext.ai.admin.settings.noKeyNeeded: Ollama doesn't need an API key — leave this section empty.
ext.ai.admin.settings.noToolSupport: This model does not report tool-calling support, so the agent cannot run on it.
ext.ai.admin.settings.openrouterFreeBody: Free models have lower rate limits and fluctuating availability. OpenRouter currently documents 50 free requests per day without qualifying purchased credits and 1,000 per day after purchasing at least $10 in credits.
ext.ai.admin.settings.perUserHint: Stops one person occupying every slot. 0 removes the limit.
ext.ai.admin.settings.pii.addressHint: Street, city and postcode fields only. Addresses written in prose are not detected.
ext.ai.admin.settings.pii.emailHint: In user records and anywhere in prose.
ext.ai.admin.settings.pii.ipHint: Login records and player connections in console output.
ext.ai.admin.settings.pii.name: Real-name fields
ext.ai.admin.settings.pii.nameHint: First and last name fields only. Names written in prose and server, product or category names are untouched.
ext.ai.admin.settings.pii.paymentHint: Checked against the card checksum, so order numbers are left alone.
ext.ai.admin.settings.pii.secretHint: On by default: credential-like fields and token-shaped values are masked before they reach the provider.
ext.ai.admin.settings.privacyCategoriesH: Categories use exact field names and the conservative prose patterns described below. Name and postal-address masking is field-only.
ext.ai.admin.settings.privacyEnabledHint: Masks supported patterns and fields in tool results and attached context. Names or postal addresses in unstructured prose may still reach the AI provider; use provider privacy controls or external DLP where that is unacceptable. What you type is never redacted.
ext.ai.admin.settings.privacyForcedBody: OpenRouter is a public hosted provider, so redaction is locked on for every category. Your saved privacy choices are preserved and return when you switch providers.
ext.ai.admin.settings.privacyProseLimit: Names and postal addresses in unstructured prose cannot be guaranteed redacted. Deliberately typed user messages are sent unchanged.
ext.ai.admin.settings.promptTooLong: The system prompt is over the length limit.
ext.ai.admin.settings.providerSwitch: Switching away from {provider} resets the endpoint and clears the saved API key — both belong to the previous provider. Enter this provider's key before saving, or the connection will fail.
ext.ai.admin.settings.queueDepthHint: Requests are refused once this many are waiting. 0 means no queue at all: a turn that cannot start immediately is refused.
ext.ai.admin.settings.queueHint: A GPU serves a fixed number of requests at once. Past that, queueing keeps everyone moving instead of slowing everyone down.
ext.ai.admin.settings.queueHostedNote: Keep-alive, scheduled warm-up, and admission control apply only to inference running on your own hardware. This hosted provider does not need them; it is bounded by spend instead — see Budget & access.
ext.ai.admin.settings.removeKeyBody: AI requests will fail until a new key is saved.
ext.ai.admin.settings.saveBeforeProbe: Save connection changes before testing or refreshing models.
ext.ai.admin.settings.saveBeforeToolProb: Save the provider, endpoint, and model before testing tool calling.
ext.ai.admin.settings.selfHostedNotOllam: Ollama only — this endpoint ignores it
ext.ai.admin.settings.shimWarnBody: Ollama’s OpenAI-compatible API accepts context window and keep-alive settings and then ignores them. Choose the Ollama provider instead to have them honoured.
ext.ai.admin.settings.slotsHint: 0 derives it from the model probe. Match your server's parallelism.
ext.ai.admin.settings.systemPromptHint: Sent with every request to define the AI's role and tone. Keep it concise — it counts toward the token budget.
ext.ai.admin.settings.tempAgentPinned: Agent turns pin this to 0 while tools are on the table, so tool selection stays repeatable.
ext.ai.admin.settings.tempCreativeHint: Highly varied. Good for brainstorming, not debugging.
ext.ai.admin.settings.tempFocusedHint: Mostly factual with slight variation. Recommended.
ext.ai.admin.settings.toolCallingUnsuppo: The live test did not get the required tool call from {model}. The agent is blocked for this model.
ext.ai.admin.settings.toolCallingUnverif: Tool calling has not been tested for this model. The test makes one small inference request and may load the model.
ext.ai.admin.settings.toolResultBytesHin: Longer results are truncated before the model reads them.
ext.ai.admin.settings.warmHint: Ping Ollama every 5 minutes so the model stays loaded and nobody hits the 20–60s cold start.
ext.ai.admin.subtitle: Provider health, usage analytics and configuration for the panel's AI assistant.
ext.ai.admin.title: M12Labs-AI
ext.ai.admin.tools.consoleHint: Console commands on this list run behind a normal approval. Everything else needs the server name typed out.
ext.ai.admin.tools.consoleWarning: This list fails closed: any command not on it — including ones nobody anticipated — is treated as destructive.
ext.ai.common.states.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ext.ai.permission.read.description: See the AI configuration, usage and logs, and use the admin AI assistant.
ext.ai.permission.update.description: Change the provider, model, limits, tools and privacy settings. Changing the provider connection or API key also requires the Owner.
ext.ai.secret.apiKey.help: Required for Anthropic, OpenAI and OpenRouter. Optional for Ollama and other local servers. Switching provider clears it.
ext.ai.server.agentDisabledBody: An administrator needs to enable the AI agent before this server’s assistant can be used.
ext.ai.server.agentDisclaimer: The agent acts with your permissions and asks before it changes anything.
ext.ai.server.approval.batchUnreviewed: Open the {count} remaining changes before approving.
ext.ai.server.approval.confirmBody: {tool} can destroy data or interrupt players on {server}. Type the server name to confirm.
ext.ai.server.approval.title: Approve: {tool}
ext.ai.server.decision.retry: The server did not accept that response. You can try again.
ext.ai.server.deleteBody: Delete “{title}”? This conversation and its transcript will be permanently removed.
ext.ai.server.detail.title: Session detail
ext.ai.server.disclaimer: AI responses may be inaccurate — verify before making changes.
ext.ai.server.drawer.running: The assistant is still working — open to watch, or check back shortly.
ext.ai.server.emptyAgentSubtitle: Ask me to change a setting, read a config, take a backup or look into a crash on {name}. I'll show you what I'm about to do before I do it.
ext.ai.server.emptyAgentTitle: What should I do for your server?
ext.ai.server.emptySubtitle: Ask anything about {name} — crashes, configuration, plugins, performance. I can see your server's basic setup.
ext.ai.server.emptyTitle: How can I help with your server?
ext.ai.server.endedStepLimit: The assistant reached its step limit and stopped here. Ask it to carry on if it was on the right track.
ext.ai.server.endedTimeLimit: The assistant ran out of time and stopped here. Ask it to carry on if it was on the right track.
ext.ai.server.queue.waiting: Waiting for a free slot — {ahead} ahead of you
ext.ai.server.restrictedBody: AI features for standard users haven't been enabled by your administrator.
ext.ai.server.resumedBody: This turn kept running while you were away. Catching up now.
ext.ai.server.slowHint: The model is loading — the first response can take up to a minute…
ext.ai.server.stalled: The connection to the assistant stopped responding. The turn may still be finishing; this transcript will refresh from the server before you can retry.
ext.ai.server.stopped: You stopped this turn. Anything already running finished and reported; nothing further was started.
ext.ai.server.suggestions.mods: How do I install plugins or mods?
ext.ai.server.title: AI Assistant
ext.ai.server.tools.admin_assist_server: Open a session on this server
ext.ai.setting.agentAdminEnabled.help: Offer the AI Assistant in the admin area.
ext.ai.setting.agentAllowDestructiveBatc: Let a batch include actions that delete or overwrite, after approval.
ext.ai.setting.agentDurable.help: Run assistant turns on the queue so a closed tab or dropped connection does not lose them.
ext.ai.setting.agentEnabled.help: Offer the AI Assistant on customers' server pages.
ext.ai.setting.agentMaxBatchCalls.help: How many operations one batch tool call may run.
ext.ai.setting.agentMaxRepairs.help: Retries after a malformed tool call.
ext.ai.setting.agentMaxSteps.help: How many tool calls one request may make.
ext.ai.setting.agentMaxToolSeconds.help: Time limit for a single tool call.
ext.ai.setting.agentMaxTools.help: 0 is automatic, sized to the model.
ext.ai.setting.agentReasoning.help: Ask models that support it to think before answering.
ext.ai.setting.agentToolResultBytes.help: Bytes of each tool result the model sees.
ext.ai.setting.budgetEnforce.help: Refuse requests once the monthly token budget is spent.
ext.ai.setting.budgetMonthlyTokens.help: Tokens the panel may spend per calendar month.
ext.ai.setting.concurrencyMaxWaitSeconds: How long a queued request waits before giving up.
ext.ai.setting.concurrencyPerUser.help: Concurrent requests per user. 0 is no limit.
ext.ai.setting.concurrencyQueueDepth.hel: Requests allowed to wait for a slot. 0 refuses instead of queueing.
ext.ai.setting.concurrencySlots.help: Self-hosted only. How many requests the model server runs at once.
ext.ai.setting.contextTokens.help: Ollama only. 0 uses the model's default, which can cost more VRAM than the weights.
ext.ai.setting.endpoint.help: Leave blank to use the provider's default address.
ext.ai.setting.keepAlive.help: Ollama only. How long the model stays in memory after a request.
ext.ai.setting.maxTokens.help: Upper bound on the length of one reply.
ext.ai.setting.model.help: The model every AI feature uses, e.g. claude-sonnet-5 or qwen3.6:27b.
ext.ai.setting.privacyEnabled.help: Replace emails, IPs and similar with placeholders before they reach the model.
ext.ai.setting.provider.help: Which AI service the panel talks to.
ext.ai.setting.systemPrompt.help: Leave blank for the built-in prompt.
ext.ai.setting.temperature.help: Lower is more predictable. Agent turns pin it to 0.
ext.ai.setting.warm.help: Ollama only. Periodically reload the model so the first request is not a cold start.
